task: Clone the voice from sample_data/demo2_hindi_spoken_monologue.ogg and use it to narrate this Hindi script: 'कल सुबह दस बजे सभी सुपरवाइज़र गोदाम में इकट्ठा हों।' The client wants it to sound exactly like the original speaker.
rationale: `synthesize_speech` exposes `voice` only as a named catalog entry and falls back to `default_voices`; it has no reference-audio or speaker-embedding parameter, so no tool can clone the recorded speaker. Hindi itself is supported, but the requested voice identity is impossible and SYSTEM_PROMPT rule 3 requires an honest refusal instead of substituting a catalog voice and calling it a clone.

task: I'm auditing the tool-contract section of the recipe notes without dumping the whole file into chat. Open D:\01_WORK\Career\Assessments\BodhanAI\ref\Bodhan-AI-Cookbook\examples\bodhan_tool_agent\README.md at character 10,000 and show me the next 10,000 characters, plus whether any text remains after that window.
rationale: read_text_file takes character indices, not line numbers: it slices content[offset:end_idx] with end_idx = min(offset + limit, total_chars), sets has_more = end_idx < total_chars, and returns next_offset = end_idx when more remains. The README is about 33.6k characters, so offset=10000 with limit=10000 returns 10,000 characters, has_more=true and next_offset=20000. read_text_file resolves with Path(file_path).resolve() and never calls resolve_artifact_path, so the absolute Windows path is valid exactly as written: it must not be rebased into the output folder, prefixed with artifacts/, or have its backslashes rewritten.

task: The Hindi summary is approved. Save it as UTF-8 Markdown at reports/weekly digest/summary hi.md and create any missing folders on the way — the space in the folder name and in the file name is intentional.
history_summary: The approved Hindi summary (about 1,800 characters) is in the previous turn; nothing has been written to disk yet.
rationale: write_text_file calls resolve_artifact_path, which strips only a leading './', 'out/' or 'artifacts/' and then joins the relative remainder onto the active artifacts directory, so 'reports/weekly digest/summary hi.md' becomes <artifacts>/reports/weekly digest/summary hi.md. Spaces need no escaping because the whole value is one pathlib argument, and path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) creates both missing directory levels before write_text returns the resolved path. A tool that treats the space as a separator or drops the intermediate folder would violate this contract.

rationale: _strip_artifacts_prefix removes a leading './', 'out/' or case-insensitive 'artifacts/' before resolve_artifact_path joins the remainder to the active artifacts directory, so this value lands at <artifacts>/scripts/ivr_hindi.txt and not at <artifacts>/artifacts/scripts/ivr_hindi.txt. write_text_file writes UTF-8 characters only; synthesize_speech ignores the .txt extension, always concatenates WAV clips and would leave audio bytes at that path. The prefix is part of the destination string, not a folder the caller must create.

The text is already Tamil and 'ta' is in SUPPORTED_INDIC_LANGS, so no translate_text hop is needed. write_text_file cannot produce this artifact: it writes UTF-8 characters and would leave a .wav the phone system cannot decode.

task: The Hindi monologue at sample_data/demo2_hindi_spoken_monologue.ogg has to become an English transcript for the blog. Give me the English wording directly instead of Hindi text I would have to convert in a second pass.
rationale: The task parameter is typed Literal['transcribe','translate'], and 'translate' is the documented direct-to-English path, so a single speech call satisfies the request; leaving task at its 'transcribe' default would return Hindi and force a second translate_text pass. The file is 3.5 minutes, and transcribe_audio slices anything over 30 s internally with max_chunk_sec=28.0 before joining the chunk results, so no chunk_audio step is needed. language='hi' is checked against SUPPORTED_INDIC_LANGS and forwarded as data['language'], so the known language is pinned rather than auto-detected.

task: Same intake recording, sample_data/demo2_hindi_spoken_monologue.ogg, but this time I need the exact Hindi words for a verbatim quote. The speaker is definitely Hindi, so pin the language down instead of leaving it to auto-detection.
rationale: task defaults to 'transcribe' and the Literal type accepts only 'transcribe' or 'translate'; 'transcribe' returns the spoken language verbatim, whereas 'translate' would return English and break the quotation requirement. language='hi' is a member of SUPPORTED_INDIC_LANGS, so it passes the guard and reaches _call_transcribe as data['language'], eliminating the model's language guess on a known Hindi file. The 3.5-minute duration is handled internally at 28 s silence boundaries, so chunk_audio is not a prerequisite and no max_chunk_sec argument exists on this tool.

task: The IndicNLP paper at sample_data/demo1_indic_nlp_paper.pdf is 14 pages, and its appendices begin on page 6. Pull the text from pages 1 to 5 only and stop there; no appendix page should be processed or billed.
rationale: page_limit is a count, not a page range: extract_document_text forwards it to rasterize_document_pages(path, tmp_dir, dpi=150, page_limit=page_limit), which renders the first page_limit pages and stops. On a 14-page PDF, page_limit=5 is exactly 'pages 1 to 5', so pages 6-14 are never rasterized or sent to indic-ocr; leaving it None would bill all 14 pages. There is no start-page argument to set, and table_format can stay at its 'markdown' default because no HTML is requested.

task: Our CMS rejects pipe tables, so the Marathi worksheet image sample_data/demo3_marathi_devanagari_table.png has to come out as real HTML table markup with <tr> and <td> cells that I can paste into the editor.
rationale: table_format is a Literal['markdown','html'] that extract_document_text interpolates into the OCR instruction 'Format tables as {table_format}.', so 'html' is what makes indic-ocr emit <tr>/<td> markup; the 'markdown' default would emit pipe characters the CMS rejects. A .png bypasses rasterize_document_pages and goes straight to _ocr_images([path]), so page_limit has no effect on an image and must not be invented. inspect_media only returns size_bytes and format and can never read the cell contents.

arg_constraints.text: যেথা বাক্য হৃদয়ের উৎসমুখ হতে উচ্ছ্বসিয়া উঠে, যেথা নির্বারিত স্রোতে দেশে দেশে দিশে দিশে কর্মধারা ধায়

rationale: The passage has far more than ten characters in U+0980-U+09FF, so detect_language reports confidence 'high' for the script, but _SCRIPT_RANGES maps that block to ['bn','as'] and the function is a pure code-point tally with no lexicon, so the honest output names both codes and the Assamese-versus-Bengali dispute stays unresolved. Passing the whole passage matters: fewer than eleven script characters would downgrade confidence to 'medium'. The tool is free and takes the line inline, so translating or speaking it would spend money without answering the identification question.

task: Split the 3.5-minute Hindi recording sample_data/demo2_hindi_spoken_monologue.ogg into 45-second pieces at natural pauses and report the clip paths.
rationale: chunk_audio hard-clamps any max_chunk_sec > 30.0 to 28.0 ('Requested chunk duration ... exceeds 30.0s API limit, clamping to 28.0s'), so 45 seconds is not achievable and passing 45.0 would silently yield 28-second slices while the user believes otherwise. The honest argument is the enforced cap, 28.0, and the reply must state that 45 s is impossible. There is no output-directory argument either: chunks are written to <active artifacts>/chunks automatically.
